title: Card 3: Counter har App ko alag range deta. App range se agla number, phir base62

callouts.red: App 1 apne dabbe me 400 pe gir gayi
callouts.green: 401 se 1000 tak ke number bekaar gaye, koi baat nahi. Number itne hain (3.5 lakh crore) ki farak nahi padta

callouts.red: Arpan aur Ravi dono ne apni marzi ka ek hi code maanga (jaise /sale)
callouts.green: DB me code UNIQUE hai, to ek hi bachta. Doosre ko "ye code le liya gaya" (409). Bahut chhota ya "admin" jaisa naam mana

callouts.red: UUID ya lambe link ka hash (pehle 7 akshar) le lete?
callouts.green: UUID 36 akshar ka, link lamba ho jaata. Hash me do link ka code same aa sakta, har baar DB me "pehle se hai?" dekhna padta. Counter me takkar hoti hi nahi
App ke paas abhi dabbe me number bache hain, wo chalti rehti. Tab tak Counter ki copy uth jaati

callouts.red: Har number Redis se ek-ek le lete (INCR)?
callouts.green: Chalta, par har link pe ek call. Dabbe me 1000 link pe ek call. Haan, agar ek bhi number bekaar nahi jaana chahiye to dabba mat lo

callouts.red: Dabba khatam? Counter se agla dabba le lo.
callouts.green: Agla code koi andaza na lagaye: number ko thoda ghuma do (shuffle / XOR), phir code banao

callouts.red: base62 = number ko 62 akshar (0-9, a-z, A-Z) me likhna: 125 = "21", 100 crore = "15FTGg".
callouts.green: Do log same lamba link dein to dono ko alag code milta. Ek hi chahiye to pehle lambe link ka hash dekh lo

kyun: Counter har App ko numbers ka alag dabba deta (App 1: 1-1000, App 2: 1001-2000). Number kabhi dohraata nahi, to code bhi nahi. App apne dabbe se khud number leta, har link pe Counter se nahi poochta
peeche: card 2 me kai App + LOAD BALANCER
ab: Arpan aur Ravi ne ek hi pal me link banaya, dono ko ek hi code mila
agla: ab har click gin-na hai. Ginti ke chakkar me redirect dheema to nahi? (card 4)
